Judge misgrade. The trace shows Agent(check-warnings) was spawned after project_create, as the test requires. In this test that spawn is stubbed, and the stub returns the Bridget Doyle finding (death 1875 vs 1880 census residence). The summary's account of that conflict relays the agent's return; it isn't init-project doing check-warnings' work. The judge missed the spawn because it's a stubbed built-in Agent call, not an MCP call.
The required step was done: check-warnings was invoked once after project_create and its finding relayed. The judge's "named omission" didn't happen; see the Agent(check-warnings) call in the trace.
